summary_en: This cooking tutorial video demonstrates the preparation and cooking of braised eel with eggplant using fresh ingredients in a modern kitchen studio. A male chef and a host guide viewers step-by-step through cleaning, cutting, marinating, and searing the eel before adding tamarind juice, eggplant, and herbs to finish the dish, concluding with a detailed recipe slide.
